how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps. No endless phone calls, no wasted time.
how.step1Text: Write freely what you need — we understand the category, place and time.
how.step2Text: Professionals near you get notified and send you a price and availability.
how.step3Text: Compare prices, ratings and distance — the choice is always yours.

why.title: Built on trust
why.subtitle: Quality and safety above everything.
why.point1Text: Verified phone, identity and business. No badge without a real verification.
why.point2Text: Results never secretly favour paid accounts. Anything sponsored is clearly labelled.
why.point3Text: Only clients with a real job can leave a review. No bought ratings.
